fact: Biometric Update reports that Morocco's 'Digital X.o' draft law, covering AI governance, data interoperability and digital identity, was still being worked on before submission to parliament, and that the Minister Delegate for Digital Transition said it clarifies data interoperability among government institutions (a draft bill, not in force); no event date is given, so the article's published date is used.
source_slug: 2025-11-06 Morocco prepares 'Digital X.o' draft law (AI governance, sectoral digital IDs, interoperability)

fact: We Are Tech Africa reports that Morocco's 'Digital X.0' framework bill, on AI, data governance, digital identity and interoperability, was under review by the General Secretariat of the Government, and that it sets an interoperability model in which any exchange of information between public agencies is authorised by the user through traceable consent (a draft bill, not in force); no event date is given, so the article's published date is used.
